meaning: Invalid profile syntax, schema, operands or safety policy; an invalid model.ignore
raisedBy: ttr-profile ProfileReader, DeclarationReader, ProfileResolver, operations; ttr-metadata YamlFileSource

meaning: A profile or declaration excludes the running grammar
A profile, overlay or ttr.yaml cannot be resolved or read within the root
The profile inheritance chain contains a cycle
An authored foreign key was neither consumed nor ignored (profile `unknown: error`, the default; under `unknown: ignore` it is a `not in this profile` warning)
A record discriminator has no kind mapping
Two operations or records own the same canonical target
A selected value (a package key, a value map) has no mapping and no default
A `package: {verbatim: true}` path is no TTR package path, or there is no string at `at`
raisedBy: ttr-profile StructuralOps (at the tree's first record)

meaning: An operation with `required: warn` selects nothing at `at` on a record (a warning; the run goes on)
raisedBy: ttr-profile RecordPlan (rename, shape, link; at the record)

meaning: Two catalogue profiles declare one identity: left out of the catalog (a warning); usage for a run naming it
raisedBy: ttr-metadata-cli lint, profile check|apply (the catalog read)

meaning: A dialect fixture has no canonical twin
raisedBy: reserved (contracts §5); the conformance roster refuses such a fixture

meaning: A record has no string ID at kinds.id or the default /$key
A file read as canonical YAML is not valid canonical YAML
An each op's `at` selects something other than a list
A values op with `split` selects something other than a string
A link names nothing in the run or its sidecars
A link names more than one target
A link's kind operand names a kind the reference has no record of (it names only other kinds)
A join-pairs value is not exactly `a.x = b.y [AND c.z = d.w …]` (two-part references, equality only)
An overlay entry names no emitted definition (its suggestion may carry a rename)
An input a generated file's header names changed since generation, or is not found
A generated file's body differs from a fresh generation of its inputs, or its header is malformed
A captured snapshot exceeds 5 MiB and --large was not given
